title: Which Friend Gets My Face
tests: Tests clarification of an ambiguous target face and preservation of the unselected person.

checks.name: asks first (Which person in two-friends.jpg should receive the user's face: the bearded man on the left or the blonde woman on the right?)

got.question: Which person in the beach photo should receive your face—the person on the left or the person on the right?

faults.what: The bearded man's face was substantially changed, including his eyes, eyebrows, nose, cheeks and smile, despite explicit instructions to leave him alone. Both faces were edited rather than just the woman's.

judge.summary: The right woman's face is plausibly swapped and blended, but the man's face was also substantially altered, violating the central instruction.

must_haves.item: Only the woman on the right receives the face from portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: The output visibly changes both people's facial features, not just the woman on the right.

must_haves.item: The bearded man's face on the left remains unchanged.
must_haves.why: His original facial features are replaced with noticeably different eyes, eyebrows, nose, cheeks and smile, although his hair and beard remain.

must_haves.item: The replaced face is recognizable and blended to match the beach lighting and head angle.
must_haves.why: The right woman's edited facial features resemble the portrait and are smoothly integrated with the sunny lighting and existing head angle.

must_haves.item: The original bodies, clothing, beach background and wide framing remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The bodies, clothing, ocean, sand and image composition appear preserved.
No text is visible in the output.
